facts.fact: Linfodrome reports that the instant criminal-record service was led by the Justice Ministry's Direction des systèmes d'information with the national criminal-record centre (CNCJ), with no contractor named.

The instant criminal-record certificate service, led by the Justice Ministry's own information systems directorate, went live on service-public.bj on 1 November 2026, per the ministry's press release of 2 November.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Legislation (DSI, CNCJ)
